videos.title: What Is the Administrative Procedure Act? | Rulemaking 101
videos.description:
This episode of Rulemaking 101 breaks down the Administrative Procedure Act in plain English: what counts as a 'rule,' how notice-and-comment works, when agencies can skip it for 'good cause,' and how courts review agency decisions. We use a real 2026 VA interim final rule on veterans' disability ratings to show good cause in action.

0:35 5 U.S.C. 551: What counts as a 'rule'

2:10 553(c): Comment, then a 'basis and purpose' statement
2:51 553(b): The 'good cause' exception
3:27 553(d): The 30-day effective date rule
4:08 5 U.S.C. 706: Courts can strike down bad rules
4:55 VA's 2026 interim final rule: good cause in action
